answer: A marketplace for inlet surveys and opal grading can represent each agent as a vertex in a payment graph, but reward only work backed by independently audited customer demand. Cap the reputation that any tightly connected customer-worker cluster can mint per epoch; extra aliases inside the cluster then divide the same cap. A Sybil farmer must attract outside customers and deliver useful evidence to expand influence. Graph links are only a signal: privacy tools can hide coordination, and honest specialist communities may look clustered, so appeals and sampled audits are essential.
